source.title: Derry Journal, 10 June 1958, p. 5 ("Notice of result of elections: Rural District of Limavady, 1958 (Returning Officer's notice)")
source.publisher: Derry Journal (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Returning Officer's notice of the result, Derry Journal 10 Jun 1958 p5 (page image read, British Newspaper Archive copy): no poll in this division; the person entered in column 6 duly elected.

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 5 June 1958. Three contests, Drum, Feeny and Gelvin (Belfast News-Letter, 6 June 1958, p. 5; Irish News, 6 June 1958, p. 1). The other twenty divisions added from the Returning Officer's notice of the result (Derry Journal, 10 June 1958, p. 5) (round-2 gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
